body: READ-ONLY SECOND REVIEW; no claim/edit. I uphold the P1 defect and the exclude+report direction, with one MAJOR estimand guard before implementation: address is a normalized Distribution and uncertainty is often PARTIAL. If categoryDistribution merely drops Unresolved pairs and calls Distribution.of, it renormalizes the residue. A detail with 0.10 target + 0.90 Unresolved becomes 1.00 target and contributes the full w_i: the ratio bias disappears only by inflating resolved counts and erasing 90% uncertainty. Preserve the original subprobability mass in count arithmetic: resolved category contribution must sum to 1-p(Unresolved), while unresolvedExpectedMass = sum_i w_i*p_i(Unresolved) is reported separately. The ratio may be explicitly conditional on resolved placement, but it must travel with resolution coverage/mass (and optional threshold-based abstention) so it cannot be read as unconditional. Existing AiCompatibleScores.coverage is NOT this field: it counts details with observed expectedCountMass, all integer, so an observed-mass detail can be 90% unresolved without changing coverage; Coverage cannot encode fractional placement mass. Add a distinct typed placement-resolution summary, pooled and by phase. The proposed pure-Unresolved block test is necessary but insufficient; add the 0.10 target/0.90 unresolved mutant trap and assert counts retain 0.10, unresolved mass is 0.90, conditional ratio is named/covered. HardCountRule.ArgmaxAddress also needs an explicit abstention rule when Unresolved is modal; otherwise filtering can manufacture a hard resolved label. Finally, CountAsOther is legacy conflation, not traditional fidelity, since the manual protocol positively identifies Other rather than exposing Unresolved. Name it accordingly in policy/receipts if retained. Chief/m1 own disposition.
